data.solution: The request sign generated by the signature algorithm does not comply with the platform specifications. Please refer to the signature algorithm documentation and compare the test data provided in the documentation one by one to check if your own signature algorithm is correct.

The following possible reasons can be self checked:1. The code has expired. The current validity period of the code is three minutes. If it is not consumed after the timeout, the code will expire.
2. The uuid parameter has been set, which is an invalid parameter and can cause this error. Please do not set it to pass, as this parameter will be optimized in the subsequent interface documentation.
3. Repeated consumption of code. You can use the logging tool in the console to query the consumption status of the code (search for keywords based on code). If the code has already been successfully called and consumed, calling the authorization interface again will report this error.
4. Invalid code, not obtained through the authorization document link mentioned above.

children.name: attribute_list
children.desc: There are 4 types of how to fill in the content of each element in this attribute list. 1). When filling in the standard dropdown/multi-dropdown attributes, fill in "aliexpress_attribute_name_id" and "aliexpress_attribute_value_id"(For multi-dropdown, splitting them into multiple elements) 2). When filling in the attributes in which the value needs to be manually entered, fill in "aliexpress_attribute_name_id" and "attribute_value" in the element. 3). There exists a special kind of "aliexpress_attribute_value_id" of which the value represents for "Other". When encoutering this scenario, please fill in "aliexpress_attribute_name_id", "aliexpress_attribute_value_id" and "attribute_value". 4). Besides the three types mentioned above, if the seller would like to fully customized all the atttributes, fill in "attribute name" and "attribute_value" in the element.

children.name: sku_property_list
children.desc: Sku attribute object list, allowing 1-3 sku attribute objects, arranged in the order of sku attributes. The sku attribute is obtained from the category attribute interface getAttributesResultByCateId. This item value is entered as sku attribute, and ordinary category attributes cannot be entered.

children.name: status
children.desc: The status of the sku, whether it is for sale, active: for sale; inactive: not for sale

children.name: package_weight
children.desc: sku level weight, KG, please complete the required verification, up to two decimal places.For U.S. AliExpress direct sellers, the unit can be either pounds or ounces, where pounds can have a maximum of two decimal places and ounces must be a whole number.

children.name: package_height
children.desc: sku level height. cm, please complete the required verification.For U.S. AliExpress direct sellers, the unit is in inches.

children.name: package_width
children.desc: sku level width. cm, please complete the required verification.For U.S. AliExpress direct sellers, the unit is in inches.

children.name: package_length
children.desc: sku level length. cm, please complete the required verification.For U.S. AliExpress direct sellers, the unit is in inches.

children.name: country_code
children.desc: Country code, for example Spain: ES

children.name: money_value
children.desc: Supply price corresponding to the destination country

children.name: country_goods_value
children.desc: Value of goods corresponding to the supply price in the destination country

children.name: country_logistic_value
children.desc: Logistics costs corresponding to the supply price in the destination country

children.name: dest_country_supply_price_list
children.desc: The supply price by destination country is optional. If you need to set the supply price for different destination countries, you can pass it through this field. For example, if the supply price for Spain is [{"ES":"23.43"}]

children.name: sku_id
children.desc: skuId, a unique identifier generated internally by AE. When editing a product, if the sku sales attribute has not changed, you need to fill it back. If the sales attribute has changed, you can pass it empty

children.name: package_weight_unit
children.desc: The weight unit for SKU in the United States (applicable only to U.S. sellers) is as follows: 1 represents pounds and 2 represents ounces.

children.name: glo_logistic_value
children.desc: GLO Dimension Supply Price Logistics Fee

children.name: package_type

children.name: currency_code
children.desc: Currency unit. If this value is not provided, it will default to "USD"; non-Russian sellers do not need to provide this attribute value. For Russian overseas sellers, this unit value must be provided, such as: "RUB".

children.name: support_country_supply_price
children.desc: Whether to support the setting of the supply price by destination country. The default value is false. If you need to set the supply price by destination country, pass true, and the dest_country_supply_price_list of the sku dimension will be used to obtain the supply price of the destination country.

children.desc: Product ID, required for editing interface

children.name: size_chart_id_list

children.name: delivery_time

children.name: mobile_detail

children.name: web_detail
children.desc: PC-side detailed description content, please note!!! For the verification rules of PC-side detailed description content: the number of related modules (relation) is at most 1, and the total number of information modules under PC-side detailed description is at most 3. When type="html" and its content contains related modules (relation) or custom modules (custom), the related modules and custom modules will also be counted. Please check whether there are related modules (relation) and custom modules (custom) in the "html" module. Please do a pre-check to avoid repeated counting. For the specific format, please refer to: https://open.aliexpress.com/doc/doc.htm#/?docId=725

For the verification rules of PC-side detailed description content: the number of related modules (relation) is at most 1, and the total number of information modules under PC-side detailed description is at most 3. When type="html" and its content contains related modules (relation) or custom modules (custom), the related modules and custom modules will also be counted. Please check whether there are related modules (relation) and custom modules (custom) in the "html" module. Please do a pre-check to avoid repeated counting. For the specific format, please refer to: https://open.aliexpress.com/doc/doc.htm#/?docId=725

data.solution: 1. Verify that the product_id belongs to the authorized account (channel_seller_id) and is still valid. Do not reuse cached or stale IDs from other business lines - first call the product list/search API to obtain up-to-date product IDs, then query the details. 2. Make sure the product has not been deleted and is a Local Cross-Border (Local CB) product; remove any deleted or non-owned product IDs from your request batch and retry.

children.name: data
children.desc: Core Field List 1. status - Invoice Status Type: String Description: Indicates the review status of the invoice Example: "REVIEW_SUCCESS" (Review successful) Field Path: dataSource[].status 2. nfeTotalValue - Invoice Total Amount Type: Object Description: Total amount of the NFE invoice, including currency information Example: amount: 128.5, currencyCode: "BRL" (128.5 Brazilian Real) Field Path: dataSource[].nfeTotalValue.amount and dataSource[].nfeTotalValue.currencyCode 3. invoiceNumber - Invoice Number Type: String Description: The invoice number of the NFE Example: "12345" Field Path: dataSource[].invoiceNumber 4. invoiceKey - Invoice Key Type: String Description: The unique identification key of the NFE invoice (44 digits) Example: "35210812345678000123550010000123451234567890" Field Path: dataSource[].invoiceKey 5. sender_cnpj - Sender Tax ID (CNPJ) Type: String Description: The CNPJ tax ID of the sender (seller) Example: "12345678000123" Field Path: dataSource[].extendInfo.sender_cnpj 6. sender_ie - Sender IE Number Type: String Description: The state registration number (Inscrição Estadual) of the sender Example: "123456789012" Field Path: dataSource[].extendInfo.sender_ie 7. recipient_cpf - Recipient Tax ID (CPF) Type: String Description: The CPF tax ID of the recipient (buyer) Example: "12345678901" Field Path: dataSource[].extendInfo.recipient_cpf 8. printInvoiceDate - Invoice Issue Date Type: Long (Timestamp) Description: The print/issue date of the invoice, Unix timestamp in milliseconds Example: 1634567890000 (Corresponds to: 2021-10-18) Field Path: dataSource[].printInvoiceDate

children.name: ipm_sku_stock
children.desc: The actual saleable inventory attribute of SKU is ipmSkuStock. The reasonable value range of this attribute value is 0~999999. If the product has SKU, please make sure that at least one SKU is in stock, that is, the value of ipmSkuStock is 1~999999. The range of the inventory value of the entire product latitude is 1~999999. If the skuStock attribute is set at the same time, the system will give priority to the ipmSkuStock attribute; if the ipmSkuStock attribute is not set, the system will set the inventory according to the skuStock attribute, true means 999, false means 0.

children.name: sku_stock

children.name: sku_price

children.name: currency_code

children.name: sku_code
children.desc: SKU merchant code. Format: single-byte alphanumeric characters, length 20, excluding spaces greater than and less than signs. If the user only fills in the retail price (productprice) and product code, a complete SKU record needs to be generated and submitted, otherwise the product code cannot be saved. The system will think that only the retail price has been submitted, but there is no SKU, resulting in unsaved product editing.
